# Release runbook

Ship **carefully** and *calmly*, never ***rushed***; run `bun run verify` first. Old advice is ~~struck~~ and underlines are dropped.

See [**the docs**](https://ctxlayer.example/docs) for details.

## Clamped heading

- parent bullet
  - nested child

1. first step

2. second step

- [x] done thing

- [ ] todo thing

- toggle head
  toggle body

> Measure twice,
> cut once.

const x: number = 1
